description: Delete all reactions across all emojis and users on a single message. This permanently clears the reaction list for everyone. To remove only a single emoji type across users, use discord_delete_all_message_reactions_by_emoji; to remove only the bot's own reaction, use discord_delete_my_message_reaction. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History, Manage Messages. Destructive: the user is asked to approve the exact change before it runs.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread holding the message

message_id.description: ID of the message to clear all reactions from
